

# A header, set apart from what follows.

blueprint:   hard   # what it is called
description: "a # that is not a comment: nor is this colon"
permissions: [ shell,fleet ]



params:
    port: 7379        # a default
    # said before owner
    owner:
    profile: {type: string,   default: release, enum: [debug,release]}
state:
  builds: 0
steps:
  # the first step
  build:
      do: shell
      when: ${params.port>0&&contains(params.owner, "{}")}
      with:
        run: |
            cargo build
              --profile ${params.profile}

            echo "# not a comment"
        env: { A: "${  params.owner  }", B: '${ params.port }', C: "$${ left }", D: "a \" ${ x }" }
      # the end of build
  folded:
    do: log
    with:
      message: >-   # folded
        one
        two
  wide:
    do: emit
    with: { topic: shop.said, first: "${params.owner}",   # the first
            # before second
            second: '${ params.port ? "a:b" : "c,d" }', third: [1, 2, 3], fourth: { deep: true } }
  list:
    do: shell
    with:
      cmd:
      - git
      -   status   # short
      # before the last
      - "--porcelain"
    on_finish:
    - do: log
      with: { message: done }
    -   emit: { topic: shop.built }
  empty:
    do: noop
    with: {}
    needs: []
  # a step that was taken out
  #   and its line
on:
  poke:
    event: shop.poke
    do: log
    with: { message: "poked" }
  # the very last word
